column1: # K5-only forms: the binary answers them and the shell has none of its own to compare (the
# shell's `cli status` only points at the binary). They are out of the parity
# coverage count (scripts/parity-coverage.py), and each names the unit tests that cover it,
# as <file>::<test fn>, comma separated. Each must be a census form, and each test must exist.
# A form leaves the coverage count only by this list: the gate fails when one leaves the census
